instagram.author: goldenstateof.mind
instagram.body:
April recap: $23k in sales on Poshmark, eBay and Vestiaire 📊

Here’s the breakdown:

Poshmark: $10,070
eBay: $8,954
Vestiaire: $4,866
Gross Sales: $23,890

Returns/Refunds: $3,024
Net Sales: $20,866

Shipping Costs: $325
Platform Fees: $3,544
Earnings (Before COGS): $16,997

Returns were HUGE in April. In fact, this was the most returns I’ve ever had in a single month. If you accept returns, did you see the same?
I sell luxury shoes on Poshmark, eBay, and Vestiaire. Let's see how much I made last month. This is super surprising, but Poshmark actually beat all of my other platforms. It brought in $10,070 in sales. But eBay was not far behind, with $8,954. Finally, Vestiaire brought in $4,866, which brought me to a total of $23,890 in sales over 65 items. But people are really tightening up their budgets right now, so my eBay returns were huge last month. I saw a total of $3,024 in refunds, which is the most I've had in any single month ever. So, this took my sales down to $20,866. I don't share my cost of goods publicly, but we can take a look at the other expenses I incurred in order to make these sales. I do offer free shipping and free returns on eBay, and that cost me a total of $325 in shipping charges. I also paid $3,544 in selling fees across all platforms. So, these expenses took me down to $16,997 in earnings before cost of goods sold. If you accept returns on any of your platforms, I'm curious if you saw a huge increase in April. Let me know in the comments.

Real time, real life people were on there saying don't go here. You know, the whole place is trash.
